releases.title: Guided STT narrator review for unmapped audio
releases.summary: Adds a user-confirmed Scan STT review flow that transcribes a short audio intro, asks the configured LLM for narrator evidence, validates the narrator against provider metadata when available, and carries accepted evidence into manual import.

new: Scan STT opens a full review modal with live/polled job progress.
Deep audio identify uses the first 60 seconds of audio instead of scanning whole files.
The review modal shows transcript text, intro audio playback, narrator suggestion, validation status, and a confirm action.
Accepted narrator evidence and validated edition hints flow into manual import review.
notes: AI/STT remains opt-in and never auto-imports files.
Normal matching and manual import still work without OpenRouter or STT configured.

new: Public release notes should expose the dev STT narrator review entry.
The public update manifest can consume this entry when dev update packages are published.
Website changelog entries should distinguish app/container changes from public-site/update-service changes.
